# Maho

> Maho is three agents that live where you already are — text, email, group chat. They never make up what they can't check, and they only act inside the rules you gave them. All three are OpenClaw agents running on Plow.

## Agents

- [The Founder Times](https://aiworthusing.com/agent-index/thefoundertimes): your morning paper, printed on your Mac or sent as a PDF in chat. Source: https://github.com/jeanjacintho/the-founder-times-openclaw-agent
- [Meetly](https://aiworthusing.com/agent-index/meetly): a scheduling assistant on a text thread. It books meetings inside your hours and tells you afterwards. Source: https://github.com/jeanjacintho/meetly-openclaw-agent
- [aha](https://aiworthusing.com/agent-index/aha): watches what the public says about your company and texts you a daily digest. Source: https://github.com/jeanjacintho/aha-openclaw-agent

## Base

- [Plow Chat](https://howto.plow.co/): each agent has its own phone line
- [Latch](https://howto.plow.co/latch): how the agents reach the owner's Mac
- [Agent Index](https://aiworthusing.com/agent-index): where each agent is listed and set up
- [OpenClaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw): the agent runtime

## Optional

- [Full description](/llms-full.txt): what each agent does and the rules it follows
